title: TommyLog TECH - Amazing Samsung Support #VZWbuzz
description: Hey Kids, it's Tommy, and for today's TommyLog TECH I want to tell you a story. The story starts out very sad. As I begin my tale I need to tell you about my Samsung Galaxy Note 5 and someone who put the S – Pen in wrong. Putting the S – pen in backwards causes significant problems with the device. One of them is that it will never come out again without permanently damaging the device. I didn't know what to do. So I decided to chat with Samsung's online support.   I had no idea the outcome of this process. this was all new territory for me, using Samsung's tech and repair processes. This story has the happiest of happy endings! I cannot thank Samsung enough for how great they took care of me and how fast the repair was.  Samsung technical support is totally Tommy approved!  Do you need support for your Samsung product? -- click here to begin your process http://www.samsung.com/us/support/  Want a Samsung Galaxy Note 5 of your very own? Step right up and click here! http://www.verizonwireless.com/smartphones/samsung-galaxy-note-5/  [DISCLAIMER — I'm one of the cool kids who has been asked to play with and test technology for Verizon. They asked me to test and share my thoughts. All my words are original and my own.]

asr.full_text: Hey Kids, it's Tommy. And for today's Tommy log Tech I want to talk to you about what happens when things go bad with your baby. So I have a Samsung Galaxy Note 5 provided to me by my great friends at Verizon, my opinions are my own, and the most horrible thing happened, one of the benefits of the Galaxy Note series is its cool S Pen and S Pen fits kind of in the bottom here, and it pulls out and it's awesome. You can ride the screen and do all kinds of neat things, what's not awesome is when you have a friend who puts it in backwards, we are not going to do that. Because what happens is when it gets to be about here it gets caught and it won't come back out. And if you yank it out, you break the mother board and then the thing is useless – that is bad. but what do you do when your thing is stuck? You go to samsung.com and you try their service and I have to tell you Samsung's service is pretty darn great. Let me share with you my experience. I began my journey to get this fixed and I thought I was going to have to pay to get this fixed, and I thought I was gonna have to pay to get it fixed online I started with a chat. Here I am with my my phone where this thing sticking out I was I was sad totally sad. I couldn't believe that this thing wasn't working Toke my serial number, and they referenced my address that edit edited it and then they said I had to call somebody. Oh no this is trouble. Okay so I called somebody and I got the nicest person that said Mr. Clifford as long as it hasn't been dunked in water which it had not and if the screen wasn't cracked or the back wasn't cracked as it's a glass front and glass back which it had not they said we'll take care of it! I still didn't know what level take-care it was and they sent me an email with a FedEx label on it. How cool is that? So, to my horror, as I was carrying this and playing with this in its Broken state. I accidentally dropped it. So there was a ding on this corner And a ding on this corner Ugh But I told him I told him it was scratched a little bit Packaged it just the way they wanted it Bubble-wrapped it Lots of love and kisses And I put it in the mail Four days later Dun dun dUN! Brand new, Galaxy Note 5 Works four days later dun-dun-dun brand-new Galaxy Note 5 works and check this out they even fixed this they fixed my Galaxy Note 5 beautiful pristine gorgeous Samsung support thank you oh i didn't tell you the best part about it Zero Zilch nada! Not a dime! Not a peso! Dinera- Nothing! How awesome is that! Samsung Service! Totally 100 percent Tommie approved. Thank you to my good friends at Samsung and they didn't know me from Adam. I just use it so you guys will get the best support out of them ever it was fantastic! Is it AppleCare good in this experience it certainly was is everybody's experience I can't say but Samsung did Tommy right this is Tommy with Tommy Laug Tech, Samsung did me right I This is Tommy with Tommy Log Tech, Samsung Did Me Right. I will talk to you guys later, bye.
